patterns.note: Content is presented in a single, wide, centered column with generous vertical spacing, creating an airy, editorial feel reminiscent of a print publication.
A large, elegant serif font is used for prominent titles and branding, contrasting with a clean, understated sans-serif for body text and navigation elements, often in uppercase.
The primary color scheme is a high-contrast black and white, providing a stark, sophisticated backdrop for the warm, earthy tones found within embedded photographic content.
The site features a persistent, sticky header with minimal elements. The initial hero section, a grid of small objects, scrolls up and out of view to reveal the main page content below.
Main content sections are composed of long-form text blocks interspersed with large, single images, often full-width within the content column, mimicking a magazine spread.

technique_notes: The site employs a sticky header that remains visible at the top of the viewport throughout scrolling, providing constant access to navigation. The initial hero section, which is a grid of static objects, scrolls away as the user moves down the page, revealing the main content area with a simple vertical transition.

Content is structured within a single, wide, centered column, ensuring a focused reading experience and a clean, spacious aesthetic. This layout is consistently applied across different page types, reinforcing the editorial feel.

Typography is designed with a clear hierarchy: a sophisticated display serif font is used for prominent titles and branding to establish an elegant tone, while a highly legible sans-serif is used for all body text and navigation elements, ensuring clarity and a modern contrast.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, elegant serif display headings (~4-5x body) with smaller, uppercase sans-serif navigation and labels. Body text is legible and well-spaced.
design_tokens.spacing: very airy, especially in the hero and between major sections; text blocks have generous line height and paragraph spacing.

standout: This site's design is distinctive for its highly editorial and academic aesthetic, leveraging a sophisticated display serif font for branding and titles, combined with a minimalist black and white palette. It feels more like a curated digital publication or art catalog than a typical marketing site, creating a unique sense of gravitas and artistic focus.
